# Conformance cases for the regular expression engine of the IndexedDB store (src/indexeddb/regex.ts).
# The expectations are the results of the Rust regex crate that the SDK depends on, and sdk/rs/tests/selector_regex_fixture.rs checks them.
#
# Each line is one record. Hex fields are lowercase and may be empty.
#   H <hex>              One input. Every pattern runs against every input, in file order.
#   P <hex>              A pattern in UTF-8, followed by its status line.
#   OK <names>           The pattern compiles. <names> holds the name of every capture group
#                        separated by commas, group 0 first, empty for an unnamed group.
#                        A results line follows.
#   UNSUPPORTED <names>  The pattern compiles, and the TypeScript engine rejects it as outside
#                        its subset.
#   ERR                  The pattern does not compile.
#   ERR UNSUPPORTED      The pattern does not compile, and the TypeScript engine reports it as
#                        unsupported. Its documentation names these cases.
#   R <results>          One result per input separated by spaces. N is no match. M is followed
#                        by start-end of every group separated by commas, x for a group that
#                        took no part.
